name: hermes
description: Author and run custom Hermes playbooks. Scaffolds a new playbook adapter from a plain-English description of the job (implementing the Playbook protocol with TDD), registers it via dynamic discovery (no engine edit), verifies it with a dry run, and kicks it off across a crew. Hermes is the standalone engine for multi-agent work across a fleet; this plugin is the authoring front-end for its playbook extension axis.
